M0.construction_data: paired-mean activation directions and random directions
M0.coordinate_invariance: orthogonal and common scalar changes only, not general GL(d)
M0.object_type: metric on the unit-sphere images; pseudometric on nonzero raw vectors

M1.complexity: fit O(nd min(n,d)); pair Gram O(K^2 d + K d rank)
M1.coordinate_invariance: unregularized covariance form is GL(d)-covariant; the isotropic ridge breaks general GL(d) invariance and preserves orthogonal/common-scale transformations
M1.formula: sqrt(2-2 v_i^T Sigma_lambda^-1 v_j / sqrt((v_i^T Sigma_lambda^-1 v_i)(v_j^T Sigma_lambda^-1 v_j)))
M1.input: controller directions plus label-free prompt-boundary activation covariance
M1.normalization: each vector is unit-normalized in the regularized inverse-covariance norm
M1.object_type: metric on normalized SPD-inner-product sphere; raw-vector pseudometric

M2.construction_data: 12 label-free probes, fixed teacher continuation, 4 checkpoints
M2.coordinate_invariance: invariant to a consistent internal reparameterization that preserves model outputs; not defined from coordinates alone
M2.inner_product: sqrt(JS) is Hilbert-embeddable, but V2 did not construct an intervention-space quadratic form or explicit Gram matrix
M2.input: full-vocabulary logits under finite sustained interventions
M2.normalization: equal-weight mean over probe/checkpoint rows; natural-log JS; square root
M2.object_type: output-response pseudometric on controllers; sqrt(JS) product distance, with zero possible for distinct controllers with identical captured responses
M2.radial_information: finite response magnitude is present, but no baseline response was captured, so the frozen object has no identified origin/radius/angle decomposition
